title: Exploring the mechanism of action of podophyllotoxin derivatives through molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation and MM/PBSA studies.
authors: Mishra, Anamika; Mulpuru, Viswajit; Mishra, Nidhi
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接、MD和MM/PBSA探讨鬼臼毒素衍生物与微管蛋白及拓扑异构酶II的相互作用，但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，仅拓扑异构酶涉及DNA结合位点，与本课题TF-DNA互作无关。
abstract: The chemical structure of a compound directly affects its biological activity, as different functional groups can change a compound's activity. With this in mind, the current study aims to predict the likely mechanism of action of several podophyllotoxin derivatives whose biological activities have already been documented. The interactions of the derivatives of podophyllotoxin with tubulin (PDB ID: 6NNG) and topoisomerase II (PDB ID: 3QX3), the two recognised targets of podophyllotoxin, were examined using molecular docking experiments. According to the molecular docking result, tubulin, and the investigated variants of podophyllotoxin interact more effectively than topoisomerase. The greatest docking score of the compounds was -12.200 against tubulin and -4.511 against topoisomerase, indicating that tubulin is the target of these drugs. Further to ascertain the strength of the interaction between the best-docked derivatives and the target protein, additional molecular dynamics investigations were also incorporated. With tubulin, the derivatives engage steadily, while with topoisomerase, the ligands shift from the protein's initial binding site to its DNA binding site. MMPBSA analysis was used to examine the stability of their relationship.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 化合物的化学结构直接影响其生物活性，因为不同的官能团可以改变化合物的活性。基于此，本研究旨在预测几种已记录生物活性的鬼臼毒素衍生物的可能作用机制。通过分子对接实验，研究了鬼臼毒素衍生物与其两个公认靶点——微管蛋白（tubulin，PDB ID: 6NNG）和拓扑异构酶II（topoisomerase II，PDB ID: 3QX3）之间的相互作用。根据分子对接结果，微管蛋白与所研究的鬼臼毒素变体之间的相互作用比拓扑异构酶更为有效。化合物对微管蛋白的最高对接评分为-12.200，对拓扑异构酶为-4.511，表明微管蛋白是这些药物的靶点。为进一步确定最佳对接衍生物与靶蛋白之间相互作用的强度，还纳入了额外的分子动力学研究。与微管蛋白结合时，衍生物稳定结合；而与拓扑异构酶结合时，配体从蛋白质的初始结合位点转移到其DNA结合位点。采用MMPBSA分析来考察它们关系的稳定性。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
